title: FaxRxTx estimate
headline: FaxRxTx — the estimate, end to end
subject: Case FaxRxTx · worldwide fax send/receive back-end, second version (Venali, 2007–2009) · a participant's recollection · outcome known, opened after the estimate
standfirst: A fresh end-to-end estimate on the current chain: a product model, a work model and size classes by three isolated sensors, priced from a pinned table of external norms; an outside view by two independent launches; gap-blind Step C rates; a diagnosis that reconciled the units before attributing anything. The answer is 17 350 net task hours (about 152 staffed person-months), a rate corridor of 11 795–26 330, and an unresolved class tail. The remembered outcome, opened only after the document was fixed, is 120 staffed person-months — the centre is ×1.26 above it, inside the corridor.
hint: What each width is. The red bell is the calibrated centre with the chain's O/M/P co-variation at an assumed ρ = 0.5, scaled by the calibration — it does not contain the product-model spread (×1.10 on leaves here), the rate table being one sample, the team's grade, or the unit-factor dispute. The grey band is the Step C rate envelope (all lows, all highs) — not percentiles. The blue curves are two launches of the outside view: their width is the heterogeneity of the class; the distance between them (×1.57 at P50) is the level uncertainty between readings and is not a width. Each outside curve was converted from its own declared unit (RC65-1: recorded 168-h months ×126 net h; RC65-2: staffed months ×114.5). The black mark is the outcome as remembered, ±20%. The twenty thin ochre curves are the no-method control (runs 41 and 43, 26–27 August): the same requirements and assumption log handed to a bare agent with no method, twenty times, each run's own P10–P90 fitted as a lognormal, drawn as a family and never pooled. Added by the author beside the run-61 estimate; not a reading of this run.
centre_note: 17 350 net task hours (17 100–17 597) — the table-priced chain 10 020 × the gap-blind Step C chain to G2, ×1.73. ≈ 152 staffed pm at 114.5 h.
calibration_note: The envelope of the Step C rates, all lows and all highs together, both sizing repeats. Not percentiles. 11 795 – 26 330 net task hours ≈ 103–230 staffed pm.
outside_note: RC65-1 and RC65-2, each in its own unit, converted by the pinned convention; ×1.57 apart. Not averaged.
against_outcome_note: outcome / centre: the calibrated centre is ×1.26 above the remembered 120 pm and just above its own ±20% band; the raw chain was ×1.37 below.
repeat_note: Two independent size classifications of one product model, 95.6% class agreement, priced from the same table. The product-model pair (×1.10 on leaves) is not in this figure.
reserve_note: The raw class tails, uncalibrated: RC65-1 P80 30 240 / P90 39 060; RC65-2 P80 20 038 / P90 27 480 net task hours. The centre sits below RC65-1's P50 and between RC65-2's P50 and P80.

divergence.lead: Units first, then blind spots; the two outside launches disagree with each other more than the chain disagrees with one of them.

rows.title: Units component sized before anything was attributed
rows.text: Read unit-blind (each outside month as 168 h), the outside view sits ×2.5 and ×1.8 above the chain. Converted by the pinned convention, the gaps are ×1.89 (RC65-1) and ×1.20 (RC65-2). The factor itself is disputed: 100–146 net h per RC65-1 month, 101–133 per RC65-2 month.

rows.title: A calibration factor that was a unit
rows.text: Step C's G1 (within-day overhead ×1.25) turns net task hours into attended hours — the same step as the pinned 6-net-hours-a-day conversion. The chain is taken to G2 in net hours; the conversion to months replaces G1. Converting the post-G1 figure again would read ×1.58 against the outcome.

rows.title: Refused rows and holes
rows.text: Immersion (W-F48) and the parallel-run comparison (W-F50) were refused as rows for undeclared headcount and period; Step C priced them as COCOMO II phase shares (T3 +999, T4 +874). Holes and closure findings, account load and performance testing priced through the table (+1 012); PM residual T5 +624.

rows.title: Era, learning curve, complexity, growth
rows.text: G2 era tooling and domain learning curve ×1.15 (+2 263, the largest and lowest-confidence item); T2 unnamed requirement growth ×1.12 (+1 294); T1 complexity of the hand-built orchestration and cluster ×1.17 (+262).

rows.title: Explained share, per reading
rows.text: Against RC65-1: 83% explained, residual +1 552 h whose sign flips across the unit band. Against RC65-2: the corrections overshoot — the calibrated centre is ×1.44 above its P50 at every factor. Not closed by adjustment.

stepc_bullets: No generic uplift for testing, integration or rework — the coverage report showed the chain carries them heavily.
Omissions itemised (A1–A4) instead of a blanket percentage, which kept T2 at ×1.12 rather than ~×1.25.
A5 (cluster build-out) unpriceable — the table has no XL row for environments or hosting.
Two globals exactly: G1 (later ruled a unit) and G2.
divergence.false_convergence: The calibrated centre lands ×0.92 of RC65-1 — weak evidence: RK66's phase and complexity factors and RC65-1's anchor A-3 both come from COCOMO II, the agreement sits inside the unit band, and it is disagreement with RC65-2. The raw chain's ×1.20 closeness to RC65-2 was a coincidence of an incomplete chain and a low-anchored reading.

outcome.lead: Opened after the estimate document was fixed. A participant's memory, ±20%; the presence convention post-dates this outcome, so the case can be learned from and does not score.

rows.title: ~10 people × ~1 year = 120 staffed pm
rows.text: ×114.5 net task hours per staffed month (docs/constants.md §4a); the participant's own band 96–144 pm = 10 996–16 494 h.

rows.title: Calibrated centre 17 350 h
rows.text: Above the outcome's own band by ×1.05. Without G2 the centre would read ×1.10; without T3–T5 ×1.05 — observations about where the miss sits, not corrections.

rows.title: Rate corridor 11 795–26 330 h
rows.text: The outcome sits 13% of the way up the envelope. The raw chain's ρ = 0.5 band (7 764–12 337) does not contain it; the raw chain was ×1.37 low.

rows.title: Outside view brackets it
rows.text: RC65-1 P50 ×1.38 high, RC65-2 P50 ×0.87 low; the outcome sits near RC65-1's P30 and RC65-2's P58.

rows.title: Exit criterion v2.0
rows.text: End-to-end repeatability not measured (one product model priced); no human scale; one outcome in hand. Provenance held for the rates; the presence convention post-dates the outcome.

rows.title: A pinned projection contaminated its consumer
rows.text: assumptions_product.md quotes the immersion stage's duration in the paragraph that says it was removed. Both product-model sensors stopped at §1. The pinned file needs a new version.

rows.title: The crossing cannot see obligation texts
rows.text: It refused performance testing on a statement whose obligation (F36) states a measurable target, because its input carries coverage ids only. Performance testing entered through Step C.

rows.title: Two parser gaps in tools/chain
rows.text: The consolidator misses group definitions written as '**NAME** is …' (49 items); the assembler misses special counts written as 'so the class is **M**'. Both handled by read-time wrappers; the tools were not changed.

rows.title: Step C's G1 is a unit step
rows.text: A global 'net hours → working hours' factor overlaps the pinned presence conversion; the diagnosis asked for it to be restated as a unit step.

rows.title: Demanded rows need an output-bounded form
rows.text: W-F48 and W-F50 cannot be priced as worded (headcount × period). The rate author proposed per-candidate evaluation, per-decision records, a comparator build, per-discrepancy-class adjudication and per-week monitoring.

rows.title: F47 as a leaf is unsizeable
rows.text: 'First-version core function set, as replaced' declares a set it never names; the sizing sensors asked for an inventory of the first version's core functions.

rows.title: W-F48 and W-F50 as rows; cluster build-out (A5)
rows.text: Headcount and length of the immersion and parallel-run stages undeclared; no XL row for environments and hosting. W-F48/W-F50 enter only as Step C shares.

rows.title: The second product model
rows.text: HM61-2 (75 leaves) was not crossed or sized; the end-to-end repeat is unmeasured.

rows.title: The table's level and its day convention
rows.text: External norms, uncalibrated; if its day-based sources meant assigned days, the chain is overstated ×1.23–1.45.

rows.title: Migration, v1 upkeep, hyper-care, security, team grade
rows.text: Outside the declaration or uncovered by any rate; the reverse audit that would check the additive design has never been run.

rows.title: Tail events and calendar
rows.text: Orchestration collapse, driver/OCR instability, a failed parallel run: in the class quantiles only. Effort-to-calendar not estimated.

nomethod_note: Medians of twenty bare runs on the same text, in two batches a day apart; spread ×1.85 between runs; each run declares a corridor of about ×1.5 of its own. Their mean sits above the outcome and near the calibrated centre — on this case the bare model overshoots where on SAS it undershot.
